Class ViewExperienceAdd

java.lang.Object
guiExperienceAdd.ViewExperienceAdd
public final class ViewExperienceAdd extends Object
Add Experience form for Contributor story 3 and work-split task KG04. Uses the shared lesson page styling and session-bound WindowContext. The selected lesson ID links the experience to its parent; the member table holds the draft effort rows until Save. Selecting a row loads it for correction. Uncommitted member input blocks Save so edits are never silently discarded. Validation and persistent ownership/lock checks run again on Save.
